title: n=2 proved control: G for lambda=(2^3), delta=3: rank over Q 1 of a=1 (mult_det=1, i_det=0) -- full rank, matching the theorem (disc of a rank-<=4 symmetric matrix: full rank at delta<=4, zero at delta>=5)
notes: Foulkes Gram of the weight-(2^3) highest-weight vector (the discriminant) in Sym^3(Sym^2 C^3). det_2 is a rank-4 quadratic form, so every quadric in D_3^{det_2} has symmetric-matrix rank <= 4; the disc is full rank for delta<=4 and identically zero for delta>=5. The engine returns rank 1, matching. This is the explicit end-to-end validation of the Gram/Schur machinery on a PROVED rank drop.
